company.description: Atmeto develops machine learning software for grid-scale battery storage and clean energy systems. The company focuses on algorithms that control charging, discharging, and power scheduling for large battery assets. Its software uses reinforcement learning and other AI techniques to improve energy storage efficiency and reliability. Atmeto also provides tools for automated energy bidding and trading in electricity markets, including the California Independent System Operator market. Its products are designed for utilities, energy traders, and owners or operators of battery storage facilities seeking to improve operational and financial performance.
